summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. Adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints.

findings.title: Order detail lacks an ownership check
findings.description: order_detail looks up the order by primary key alone. It never filters the lookup by request.user. Any logged-in user can read the total and discount code of every order by enumerating ids. Add owner=request.user to the get_object_or_404 lookup, as redeem already does.

findings.fix: Add owner=request.user to the get_object_or_404 lookup, as redeem already does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float
findings.description: apply_discount multiplies the Decimal total by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError for Decimal times float. Every redeem request with the valid WELCOME10 code crashes with a server error. No user can apply the discount. Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: New model field has no migration
findings.description: The change adds the discount_code field to Order. The migrations folder holds only 0001_initial, and that migration has no discount_code column. Every Order query, including the existing order list, fails because the database has no discount_code column. Run makemigrations and commit the generated migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on session-authenticated POST
findings.description: redeem changes order state for the session user. The csrf_exempt decorator turns off the CsrfViewMiddleware check that the project's settings enable. A third-party site can make a logged-in user's browser change that user's order without consent. Remove the csrf_exempt decorator. Have clients send the CSRF token with the POST.

findings.title: Once-per-order check races with concurrent redeems
findings.description: apply_discount checks discount_code on the in-memory instance and then writes the total. Two concurrent redeem requests can both pass the check before either saves. The second redeem discounts the order a second time. The order then loses more than the intended 10 percent. Apply the discount with a conditional update filtered on discount_code being empty. Alternatively, lock the row with select_for_update inside a transaction.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour has no tests
findings.description: The repository contains no test files. Nothing tests apply_discount, order_detail or redeem. The crash in apply_discount and the missing ownership check in order_detail reached review undetected. Add tests for a valid code, an invalid code and a repeated redeem. Add a test that a user cannot read another user's order.
